summary: Frontend end-to-end validation of Commit B (CP4 Service Tickets, E3 Vendor Master, CP5 Global Search + PWA + Driver Mobile Home) on preview. All requested critical flows verified working: admin login (no compile overlay), GlobalSearch grouped results / min-length / no-match empty state, Vendor Master CRUD, 7-stage Ticket workflow (Open→Under Review→Approved→Sent for Repair→In Repair→Repaired→Closed with vendor + final cost), data_entry RBAC (no Approve/Reject, shows 'Awaiting Management or Admin approval'), vendor picker on both Service and Ticket forms auto-fills vendor, Driver Home renders with 8 tiles and 'Contact Not Configured' disabled tile, Vehicle Profile Tickets tab opens TicketDetail drawer, and PWA assets (manifest, service-worker, icon-192, icon-512) all HTTP 200. Sharma Motors Test vendor, TKT-2026-0007, TKT-2026-0008 were cleaned up post-testing. Preview app is production-ready with 1 minor UI nit noted below.

ui_bugs.issue: Occasionally the drawer subtitle displays the raw vehicle UUID (e.g. '0e572cbb-d447-4107-a08b-...') instead of the human-readable vehicle_number after rapid successive PATCH /repairs/{id}/status transitions. First open shows 'MH 12 AB 1234' correctly; after Send-to-Vendor → In Repair → Repaired the subtitle regresses to UUID. Suspected cause: TicketDetail's refetch after status action does not re-hydrate vehicle_number (routes_ops.py PATCH response may omit vehicle_number, and the component copies raw response). Reopening drawer fresh from list re-fetches with enrichment and displays correctly.

action_items: Fix TicketDetail vehicle subtitle regression: ensure PATCH /repairs/{id}/status response enriches vehicle_number OR keep the previously-loaded vehicle number in local state instead of replacing with the raw API payload.
critical_code_review_comments: GlobalSearch: single-char query returned no results but no helper hint text ('Type at least 2 characters') was rendered — behavior matches min-length=2 requirement functionally but consider adding a hint for UX clarity.
TicketDetail: works well with role gating and 7-stage timeline including timestamps + reviewer name. Photos section shows 0/8 correctly.
Vendor picker on Send-to-Vendor dialog is a native HTML <select> (not shadcn Select), which is inconsistent with other pickers on the page but functionally correct.

Driver Home: 'End Trip' tile appears NOT disabled because driver1 actually has an ongoing trip (banner 'Ongoing trip — MH 12 AB 1234'); requirement to show disabled applies only when no ongoing trip. Verified logic OK.
Vehicles route /vehicles/{id} and Vehicle Profile → Tickets tab correctly opens the same TicketDetail drawer.
test_credentials: [REDACTED — SEC-001] Historical run used seeded default users; those default credentials have been removed. Tests now read credentials from FLEETFLOW_TEST_* env vars.
seed_data_creation: Created and DELETED: vendor 'Sharma Motors Test' (Repair, 9876543210, 27ABC1234E1Z5); tickets TKT-2026-0007 (full 7-stage workflow → closed with cost ₹5000) and TKT-2026-0008 (used for data_entry RBAC test in under_review status). Note: an existing vendor 'Sharma Motors' (without ' Test' suffix) was already present before this session and left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Commit B flows verified. TKT-2026-0001/0002/0004/0005/0006 pre-seeded tickets preserved. Backend was not retested here (frontend-only scope; prior 94/94 pytest pass). PWA /manifest.json, /service-worker.js, /icon-192.png, /icon-512.png all return 200. One minor UI regression noted: TicketDetail drawer subtitle may render vehicle UUID after rapid status transitions — reload of drawer restores vehicle_number. RBAC for data_entry confirmed: Approve/Reject hidden, 'Awaiting Management or Admin approval' shown. Vendor picker on both /maintenance (services) Add Service and /repairs Add Ticket auto-fills vendor field on selection. Driver Home renders under '/' for role=driver only with 8 data-testid='driver-tile-*' tiles.
rca_of_the_issue: Drawer-subtitle-UUID nit RCA: TicketDetail component appears to set local state directly from the PATCH /repairs/{id}/status response. GET /api/repairs performs vehicle_number enrichment (see routes_ops.py list handler) but PATCH likely returns the raw record without enrichment. Fix options: (a) enrich the PATCH response server-side to include vehicle_number, or (b) on the frontend, preserve the previously-loaded vehicle_number field when merging the PATCH response into state.
